matt-sre: :rotating_light: Starting thread for the incident — us-west GPU admission queue saturated, produced cascading throttles across hosted API and some Dedicated customers. Root cause looks like a mismatch between admission limits and an unusual spike of long-context requests. Opening for timeline/notes.
deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0453 at 2026-03-01T09:04:03Z by matt-sre
anya-eng: Observed sharp rise in inflight tokens at 09:02. Pool us-west-2/gpu-a hit 100% and admission started returning 429s. Metrics: active_streams up 6x, avg_seq_len up 2.5x.
zach-runtime: Logs show repeated admission rejections, then many clients retried aggressively. Retry storm amplified load onto fallback GPU pool and then CPU host pool. Sample log:
```
2026-03-01T09:02:45Z  admit.go:121  deny request pool=us-west-2/gpu-a inflight=251 limit=250
2026-03-01T09:02:47Z  api-proxy.go:88  429 -> client_id=acme-inc request_id=... retry-after=0
2026-03-01T09:03:12Z  fallback-proxy: routing to cpu-pool due to no gpu capacity
```
emily-ops: Customer-impact: hosted text-generation latency > 5s for 15m, 8 customers reported errors to CS. Dedicated customers on pinned pools saw increased queue times but no data loss.
jordan-cs: Filed two high-priority tickets from customers. Shared status update and ETA for next update ~09:25.
observability-bot: Alert: admission_queue_length_us-west-2 >= 2000 for 8m. Top callers: notebook-batch, acme-inc, research-sim, internal-loadtest.
sophia-plat: Quick config check — admission config for us-west-2/gpu-a was:
```
admission:
  max_inflight_per_pool: 250
  global_queue_size: 2000
  retry_backoff_ms: 100
```
matt-sre: Note we had lowered backoff to 100ms in a prior tweak to reduce perceived latency under load. That made clients retry more aggressively and contributed to amplification.
anya-eng: Mitigation timeline:
- 09:06 disable aggressive retries at edge (set retry_backoff_ms -> 1000)
- 09:08 increase admission limit on backup GPU pool by 20% as temporary relief
- 09:12 enable per-client queuing to cap noisy clients
Results: 429 rate dropped ~60% by 09:15, latency gradually recovered.
zach-runtime: Root cause hypothesis: two factors combined — longer sequence length spike (internal model eval) and too-low retry_backoff producing amplification when admission rejected. Admission logic didn't rate-limit retries correctly.
matt-sre: Post-incident actions (initial):
- Revert retry_backoff to 1000ms on all regions (done 09:06) :thumbsup:
- Add a server-side exponential jitter to retry hints (RFC queued)
- Implement per-client admission windows (PR in review by anya-eng)
- Add circuit-breaker in fallback routing to avoid overloading CPU pool (zach-runtime)
- Run load replay to validate changes before rolling to eu-west

emily-ops: Cost note: We temporarily spun up extra gpu-burst instances for 30m — estimated incremental cost $3.2k. Will include in incident cost report.
sophia-plat: Action item: audit any prior config changes that reduced retry_backoff in last 3 months. I see a change from 2026-01-22 by ops-tuning.
anya-eng: Quick repro steps for QA:
1) Run a long-context generation workload (seq_len ~8k) at 1.5x normal concurrency
2) Set client retry backoff to 100ms and aggressive retry policy
3) Validate admission returns 429 and observe retry amplification
zach-runtime: Patch plan: PR to add per-pool hysteresis + exponential retry hint merged to canary, will monitor for 1h before global roll.
jordan-cs: Customers updated: posted status to dashboard and emailed affected accounts at 09:30. No major SLA credits expected but CS will handle claims.
matt-sre: Timeline doc + preliminary RCA uploaded to /docs/incidents/1779000123-admission-throttle-cascade.md — please add any evidence or notes here. We'll schedule a full postmortem review 2026-03-02 15:00PT.
anya-eng: FYI — we also observed a cross-region peer sync (state reconciliation) that spiked control plane traffic at 09:05; investigating if that correlated with delayed cache invalidation.
observability-bot: Follow-up alert: admission_429_rate normalized by 09:20. NRT dashboards show capacity back to normal by 09:35.
matt-sre: Thanks everyone. Collecting action items and owners — will convert into tracked tickets. If you have logs/graphs, paste them into the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
